meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会从 channels 分支复制 Google Chat 适配器及其注册测试到 src/channels/,把自注册 import 追加到 channel barrel,安装 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0,再构建并运行该注册测试。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目加上 Google Chat 渠道,或正在 /setup 流程中接入这个渠道时触发。

say.text: 把 Google Chat 渠道加进这个项目
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Google Chat adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, adds a self-registration import to the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, builds and runs the test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Google Chat channel to the project, or while running /setup and need this channel.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Wire the gchat channel to an agent group with /manage-channels
say_en.note: Binds the channel to an agent group

say_en.text: Run gchat-registration.test.ts to check the channel registration
say_en.note: Red means the import or dep drifted
